guitar.notes: Jagged Little Pill was largely Ballard/session-musician driven in the studio; Alanis herself plays guitar live but no single iconic model is documented. Original entry reasonable.

tone.target: dry snarling alt-rock crunch with gritty upper mids
tone.profile: dry snarling alt-rock crunch with gritty upper mids
tone.summary: A tight, mid-focused alt-rock chain using a Boost for grit, Distortion for raw power, an AC30 TB amp model, and a UK Vintage 4x12 cab to achieve the desired snarling crunch.

rig.name: Alanis Morissette - You Oughta Know - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up background noise and tighten the rhythm playing.
Provide initial grit and tighten the attack for palm-muted rhythm.
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of OD/Green OD to maintain a raw, aggressive edge without excessive coloration.

blocks.purpose: Deliver the core raw distorted rhythm and upper-mid grit.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is chosen for its aggressive, mid-forward character suitable for alt-rock crunch.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Marshall/Plexi sound with emphasized mids and bite.
blocks.gap: The AC30 TB is ideal for achieving a British, mid-focused crunch tone.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British cabinet sound and necessary high-end punch.
blocks.gap: Essential for grounding the tone in a recognizable rock context.

blocks.purpose: Aggressively boost the upper mids to achieve the 'snarling' quality and cut through the mix.
blocks.gap: Manual EQ adjustment is crucial here to counteract any mid-scooping inherent in certain amp models, ensuring forward presence.

blocks.purpose: No modulation effects are used to keep the tone dry and urgent.
blocks.gap: The instructions explicitly state avoiding chorus wash/modulation.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle rhythmic depth without becoming ambient or wash-y.
blocks.gap: Used sparingly to add dimension, but kept low in mix and feedback to avoid 'ambient delay'.

blocks.purpose: Provide a minimal sense of space without sounding overly ambient or wet.
blocks.gap: The Room reverb is chosen for its natural decay, keeping the tone dry and focused on rhythm.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better cabinet realism and punch.

proposals.reason: Improve the perceived depth and natural resonance of the 4x12 cab.
